description:
Read or export one transcription: its status and text with timestamps and speakers, its title and summary, or the whole transcript as an SRT, WebVTT or Markdown file; as spoken or translated, at once or after waiting for it to finish.
Use: after create_transcription (waitS saves polling), or any time during a live transcription for the text so far. An overview: format summary. Subtitles or a document to save: format srt, vtt or markdown. Finding a passage in many transcriptions: search_transcriptions.
Behaviour: free. A wait ends as soon as the work does, and sends progress notifications when the client gives a progress token. lang needs a finished transcription; the first call in a new language can take up to a minute on a long one, later pages are quick. Page with offset = nextOffset.
Returns: status (state, progress, error when failed, shareUrl when it has a public link: made with shareLink in create_transcription or update_transcription), timedOut when waitS was set, then segmentCount, partial while text is still coming, text or segments, nextOffset when more remain, and lang and translated with lang. format summary returns summary instead: state ready with title and summary (and lang when translated), pending while it is written or the transcription runs, none when none was asked for (update_transcription with summary true writes one), not_requested under a minute, unavailable when it failed. format srt, vtt or markdown returns file (fileName, contentType, content: the whole file as text, partial while it runs) instead of text. A wait that runs out with lang set returns the status only.
Errors: not_found; invalid_state for lang before it is finished; invalid_options for an unsupported lang or includeWords with lang; rate_limited (with retryAfterS) when waitS is set and 4 waits are already open for this key (8 for the account), or past 600 calls a minute per API key.

format.description: text: one string, a line per segment as "[mm:ss] Speaker 1: words", for reading and quoting; segments: timed lines (start, end, text, speakerNumber, speakerName), for exact times; summary: the title and summary only, for an overview; srt, vtt or markdown: the whole transcript as a ready file (SubRip or WebVTT subtitles, or a Markdown document), returned as file with fileName, contentType and content, not paged; none: status only (with waitS: wait without reading).

includeWords.description: With format segments and no lang: also each word with its start and end second. It makes the answer several times larger, so ask for a narrow page (e.g. limit 50).

lang.description: Code of a language to read the whole text (or, with format summary, the summary) in, one of about 100 (e.g. es, de, ja): the transcription must be finished (state done, or a stopped live one). The language already spoken returns the original with translated false. Omit for the original.

limit.description: Most segments in one call. When more are left the result has nextOffset.

offset.description: Index of the first segment to return (0, the start, by default). To page, pass the nextOffset the previous call returned.

transcriptionId.description: A transcriptionId from create_transcription, list_transcriptions, search_transcriptions or start_broadcast.

waitS.description: Seconds to wait for a file or link transcription to finish before answering, 0 to 60 (0, the default: answer at once). Returns as soon as it ends; timedOut true means it is still running, so call again. Keep it under your client's call timeout. A live transcription never waits.

name: get_transcription
title: Read a transcription
